stem: 在外国司法管辖区(与总部所在司法管辖区不同)开展业务时评估和管理洗钱风险,有效的反洗钱监测计划应当:

options.B: 应根据两个司法管辖区中较高的标准进行调整.
options.C: 遵守外国司法管辖区的政策,以与总部政策保持一致.
options.D: 将所有外国司法管辖区的报告提交总部审批.

stem_en: When assessing and managing money laundering risks while operating in foreign jurisdictions different from that of the head office, an effective AML monitoring program should:

options_en.A: Be consistent with the head office audits
options_en.B: Be tailored to the higher of the standards between the jurisdictions
options_en.C: Conform to the foreign jurisdiction policies to align with the head office policies
options_en.D: Provide all foreign jurisdiction reports to the head office for approval
